cards.name: Arrow Volley Trap
cards.oracle_text:
If four or more creatures are attacking, you may pay {1}{W} rather than pay this spell's mana cost.
Arrow Volley Trap deals 5 damage divided as you choose among any number of target attacking creatures.

rulings.comment: Casting a Trap by paying its alternative cost doesn’t change its mana cost or mana value. The only difference is the cost you actually pay.
Effects that increase or reduce the cost to cast a Trap will apply to whichever cost you chose to pay.
You divide the damage as you cast Arrow Volley Trap, not as it resolves. Each target must be assigned at least 1 damage.
You may ignore a Trap’s alternative cost condition and simply cast it for its normal mana cost. This is true even if its alternative cost condition has been met.

source: Scryfall Oracle/rulings subset for offline tests
